content_zh:
而凌嬷嬷则是气喘吁吁的跑回了松柏院的正房。
凌嬷嬷进了正房，看见大夫人正在假寐，整理下衣着轻声的道：“大夫人，叶表姑娘还没有醒呢，老奴刚才路过那里，看见不少小蹄子在清花阁凑热闹，那不长脑子的王妈妈还和秀雁在争吵，”
“老奴觉着大夫人应该过去看看，虽然是表姑娘自己贪玩闹得这么大事情，但是老奴瞧着要是叶表姑娘真要有个三长两短的，到时候叶家那边难以交代。”
大夫人听闻此言睁开满是精光狭长的眼睛，微怒的道：“我就说那个小蹄子不省心，天天的缠着辉哥这样那样的，要不是看中她手里的庄子铺子，还有隔壁的那个宅子契约没到手，这种娇气任性，哭天抹泪的姑娘谁家稀罕？就是给辉哥做个贱妾都甭想，本以为给辉哥订了亲事就能让她死心，没想到闹出这样的事情，跟她那个娘一样不省事。”
启国律法规定，男子成亲正妻一位、贵妾一位、而良家妾、婢妾、贱妾、通房则是级别不同、规定不同，良家妾是出身清白人家的女子，婢妾是大户人家提上看来的奴婢，贱妾则是青楼戏伶这一类别的女子，属于妾中的最低地位。
甚至贱妾生的孩子，不论男女在聘礼嫁妆和家产上都要低于其他的孩子，所以甘愿做贱妾的人还是少的，大部分都是能漂了白才进大宅门的。
启国极少有娶平妻之人，因为律法很麻烦，娶平妻需要官府备案，还需要族里同意，和正妻家族同意，所以平妻和侧室极少出现的百姓家，只有各个王侯才有侧妃，否则律法是很严厉的。
启国有妾室可以扶正的律法，但是真正扶正的人家还是少数，大部分家庭都是娶了继室，这样一来可以扩大家族的势力，二来可以避免被人嘲笑。
大夫人气的竟然将慧姐和贱妾相比，可想而知她有多么不待见慧姐，心中有多恨，即使再恨也的端着，装着，大夫人范氏感觉自己都要郁闷的窒息了。
凌嬷嬷在一旁劝道：“大夫人老奴知道您不喜欢叶表姑娘，更不喜欢已逝的二姑奶奶，可是这个时候可不是咱们置气的时候，老奴觉得大夫人还是应该收拾一下，带着大少爷和四小姐过去看看吧，杜太医不是说了要是这两天醒不过来，还是有危险吗？”
大夫人恨得扔了眼前的大红喜气缠枝的靠垫，就像是恨不得扔了那个惹是生非让人不得安生的慧姐一般，真是牙齿痒痒的很！
要说大夫人在仁安伯府卢家最讨厌谁，已逝的二姑奶奶卢馨绝对是头一号的，早年卢馨未出嫁的时候就和她作对，攒罗老夫人不给她管家职权，这笔账到现在她范郁琴也是记得真真的呢。
还有一笔就是当年卢馨议亲的时候，本来想和范家来个亲上加亲，没想到卢馨激烈的反对，让她在娘家面前丢了不少的脸面，到现在娘家人还拿这事笑话她。
所以不知道多少次祈祷这个姑奶奶最好找个差点的亲事，没想到竟然攀上了一等靖安侯府的高枝，让她每每想起不知道多少次气闷的要死。
如今可好了，二姑奶奶在聪明又如何，命没了不说还教出来一个傻闺女，还不是在我范郁琴眼皮子底下讨生活，铺子、庄子、票子都在我手里掌握着，管保到了今年年底的时候都给变卖掏空了！。
年底就算是二姑老爷叶大人回来述职又如何？都是你自家的傻闺女作的，她自己不擅经营，奴婢奴才不尽力，和我们没有关系，左右三年孝期已过，还是带回叶家吧。
大夫人想到这里，想起白花花的银子，心情忽然好了起来！
也对，这生病了，还这么严重，这小蹄子病的真是时候，大夫人眼里精光直冒，这回就更容易说慧姐的银子都去哪里了，这人参灵芝的花的不都是银子？
许是想起了昨晚傻儿子拿的那根十年的人参，这心里还是有些火气，这个大夫人就忘了，慧姐屋子里那些从北部原城捎来的百年人参都进了谁家的库房了。
大夫人心情闷闷的抿了一口雪山眉尖的茶水，对着凌嬷嬷道：“走，咱们去清花阁瞧瞧去。”

content_en:
Nanny Ling, on the other hand, ran back to the main room of Songbai Courtyard out of breath.
Grandma Ling entered the main room and saw the eldest lady taking a nap. She straightened her clothes and said softly: "Madam, Miss Ye Biao hasn't woken up yet. I passed by there just now and saw a lot of little hooves joining in the fun in Qinghua Pavilion. The brainless Mother Wang was still arguing with Xiuyan."
"I think the eldest lady should go over and have a look. Although it was my cousin who was playful and caused such a big incident, I think that if Miss Ye's cousin really has a problem, it will be difficult for the Ye family to explain it."
After hearing this, the eldest lady opened her long and narrow eyes, and said angrily: "I would say that little hooves is careless, pestering Brother Hui every day in this way, if she hadn't taken a fancy to the Zhuangzi shop in her hand, and the contract for the house next door I didn’t get it, who is so rare for a girl who is so squeamish and willful that she sheds tears all day long? She didn’t even think about being a concubine to Brother Hui. I thought that she would give up by getting married to Brother Hui, but she didn’t expect that such a thing would happen, and she would be as trouble-free as her mother. "
The laws of Qi State stipulated that a man should marry a main wife and a noble concubine, while good concubines, maid concubines, unworthy concubines, and married women had different levels and regulations. A good concubine was a woman from an innocent family, a maid concubine was a slave from a wealthy family, and an unworthy concubine was a woman who was a brothel opera actress, which was the lowest status among concubines.
Even for children born from concubines, both men and women receive lower betrothal gifts and family property than other children. Therefore, there are still few people who are willing to be concubines. Most of them can be bleached before entering the big house.
There are very few people in Qi State who marry a common wife, because the law is very troublesome. Marrying a common wife requires official filing, and also requires the consent of the clan and the consent of the main wife's family. Therefore, in ordinary families where common wives and side wives rarely appear, only princes can have side wives. Otherwise, the law is very strict.
There is a law in Qi State that concubines can be corrected, but there are still a few families who actually correct them. Most families marry stepchildren. This can expand the family's power and avoid being laughed at.
The eldest lady was so angry that she compared Sister Hui to a bitch. You can imagine how much she didn't like to see Sister Hui and how much she hated her. Even if she hated her no more, she still pretended to be. The eldest lady Fan felt like she was suffocating with depression.
Aunt Ling advised from the side: "Madam, I know that you don't like Miss Ye Biao, let alone the deceased Second Aunt, but this is not the time for us to vent our anger. I think Madam should tidy up and take the eldest young master and the fourth young lady over to have a look. Didn't Doctor Du say that if you don't wake up in the next two days, there will still be danger?"
The eldest lady was so angry that she threw away the bright red cushion wrapped with branches in front of her, just like she wanted to throw away the troublesome Sister Hui who made people live in peace. Her teeth were really itching!
When it comes to who the eldest lady hates the most in the Lu family of Ren'an residence, the deceased second aunt Lu Xin is definitely the number one. Lu Xin had been against her in her early years before she was married, and Mrs. Zanluo did not give her housekeeping rights. Even now, Fan Yuqin still remembers this fact.
Another thing is that when Lu Xin was discussing marriage, she originally wanted to have a kiss with the Fan family. Unexpectedly, Lu Xin's fierce opposition caused her to lose a lot of face in front of her parents' family. Even now, her parents' family still laughs at her about it.
So I don't know how many times I prayed that this aunt would find a close match, but she didn't expect that she would climb to the top of the first-class Jing'an Marquis Mansion, which made her feel depressed to death every time she thought about it.
Now it's better. It doesn't matter that my second aunt is smart, but she has taught a stupid girl even if she has lost her life. She is still making a living under my nose, Fan Yuqin. The shop, the bank, and the money are all in my hands, and the guarantee will be sold off at the end of this year! .
What if Mr. Ye, the second aunt, comes back to report on his work at the end of the year? AllIt was your own silly daughter who did it. She is not good at running the business herself, and her slaves and slaves are not trying their best. It has nothing to do with us. The three-year period of filial piety has passed, so it is better to take it back to the Ye family.
When the eldest lady thought of this and the white money, she suddenly felt better!
That's right, this illness is so serious, this little hoof disease is really timely, the eldest lady's eyes are gleaming, this time it is easier to say where Sister Hui's money has gone, isn't all the money spent on this ginseng and Ganoderma lucidum money?
Maybe she thought of the ten-year-old ginseng that the silly son took last night, and she still felt a little angry. The lady had forgotten whose warehouse those century-old ginseng brought from the northern city in Sister Hui's house had gone into.
The eldest lady took a sip of the tea from Snow Mountain's brow in a depressed mood, and said to Granny Ling: "Let's go to Qinghua Pavilion to have a look."
